# Noemorph

> Go beyond the question you asked. Discover the questions you didn't know existed.

Noemorph is an open-source AI research skill for research question generation, hypothesis exploration, cross-disciplinary knowledge discovery, concept expansion, and recursive deep research. It runs in an agent client using that client's model, retrieval tools, and delegation support.

Use Noemorph when a researcher wants to find overlooked questions, explore connections between fields, or develop a research agenda from a question or hypothesis. Each round clarifies the question, explores four complementary perspectives, selects promising paths, and investigates them with evidence-linked follow-up questions. Outputs include a synthesis, a full research catalogue, and an interactive knowledge map, retaining unselected findings and uncertainty.

The bundled local viewer supports branch expansion, search, filters, source links, language variants, and HTML/JSON/SVG export. Python utilities collect settings, validate records, and render maps; they do not execute research or call models. The demo uses synthetic data. This is an early alpha with incomplete end-to-end research acceptance; no benchmark establishes superior research performance.
